s1.desc: a living room with a cream sofa against a plain pale grey wall

s2.desc: a hallway with an arched doorway, an open wooden door and a light switch on the pale wall

spans.notes: slow push in from behind the television toward the couple on the sofa (sofa edges doubled first vs last)
shake as both jolt at the noise; the foreground television jitters f23-f36
10 static frames of the wide room

spans.view: with the back of a teal television blurred in the foreground

beats.text: Polly hugs a cushion with her eyes squeezed shut while Pax sits beside her on the sofa, looking at her
Polly points a flipper off to the right while Pax watches her
Pax puffs out his chest and nods with a determined frown
Pax hops down off the sofa onto the floor in front of it
Pax waddles off to the right in front of the sofa while Polly watches, clutching her cushion

spans.notes: Pax grows a little as he hops down in front of the sofa (size_change). He is half out at the right edge by f173 but never fully exits

close-up of Pax walking in fear with sweat drops, under dramatic low-key lighting that turns his white belly grey; plain background, so the camera lock cannot be checked and Pax grows as he advances. Unsure, dropped

static, lights off: a dark blue-grey wash over the whole picture recolours Pax (belly lavender-grey); Pax slides in at f238 and peeks half hidden behind the arch. Could be kept as [238,290) at night if dark-room lighting is acceptable; dropped conservatively
pan across the dark bedroom: bed, lamp, curtain blowing, a crab silhouette; no lead
dark doorway, Pax reaches for the light switch (also dark wash)
quick zoom on a little flower crab on the bedroom floor (a side creature, not a lead)

beats.text: Pax peeks out from behind the edge of the doorway
Pax steps into the doorway with a relieved smile and gives a little wave
Pax turns and waddles back out of view behind the wall, leaving the doorway empty

spans.notes: lights on; top-right wall region identical every frame
